items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: That's the time Buster Bailey, Zoo Robinson. We had Johnny Sincere guitar... That London Blues, the Sunday Sweetheart, that was with Buster Bailey.

ctx.x: Sunday Sweetheart. That's the time Buster Bailey, Zoo Robinson. We had Johnny Sincere guitar. Who was playing bass? I think Bill Johnson was playing bass. I'm not mistaken. The Jellarole Martin.
Could it have been the Horace Eubanks song?
